title: Step 2 - Creating Generic Code Templates for Various Regression Models in Python

cues.en: Instructor: And now what is this data set about?
cues.zh: 這個資料集是關於什麼？

cues.en: Well, that's a classic data set from actually the UCI machinery repository which I encourage you to have a look because indeed there is a website that contains a lot
cues.zh: 它是 UCI Machine Learning Repository 的經典資料集。我建議你看看，網站提供許多

cues.en: of data sets on which you can practice.
cues.zh: 可練習的資料集。

cues.en: And this one is actually called Combined Cycle Power Plant.
cues.zh: 這份叫做 Combined Cycle Power Plant，複循環發電廠資料集。

cues.en: And it consists of trying to predict this dependent variable which is actually an energy output and don't really, you don't have to understand how energy works
cues.zh: 目標是預測這個應變數，也就是能源輸出；不必真的理解能源運作，

cues.en: or how the physics of this data set works.
cues.zh: 或資料集相關的物理原理。

cues.en: The only thing that you need to understand is that we want to predict this dependent variable which turns out to be an energy output.
cues.zh: 只需知道，要預測的應變數剛好是能源輸出。

cues.en: And we are predicting this dependent variable with these four features here.
cues.zh: 我們使用這四個特徵預測。

cues.en: Which are first, the Amgen temperature, second the exhaust vacuum, third the ambient pressure and fourth, the relative humidity.
cues.zh: 依序是環境溫度、排氣真空度、環境壓力，以及相對濕度。

cues.en: All right, so that's only what matters here.
cues.zh: 這裡只需理解這些。

cues.en: You have to see it as you know a general dataset where you have several features that you're gonna use to predict that dependent variable.
cues.zh: 把它視為一般資料集，用多個特徵預測應變數。

cues.en: And as you can see the condition, in order to deploy our regression morals on this dataset and the future dataset you'll be working on is to have in the first columns the features
cues.zh: 要套用我們的迴歸模型，這份資料與未來資料都必須以前面欄位作為特徵，

cues.en: and in the last column the dependent variable, alright?
cues.zh: 最後一欄作為應變數。

cues.en: That's all that matters.
cues.zh: 重點只有這樣。

cues.en: If you have a dataset like that which has no missing data and no categorical data, while you can deploy each and every single one of these regression models
cues.zh: 如果符合這種格式，沒有缺失值、沒有類別資料，就能套用每個模型，

cues.en: by just having to change the name of your data set.
cues.zh: 只需修改資料集名稱。

cues.en: And if your data set has missing data or categorical data you just have to go to your data pre processing toolkit to take care of this and then you can deploy these models.
cues.zh: 若有缺失值或類別資料，先用前處理工具箱處理，再套用模型。
